header.running_head: 4. Virtues of the Dhikr of Allah...

blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Abdullah ibn Mas'ud (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “If a person commits some mistake or sin and then feels remorse for it, this remorse becomes an expiation for his sin.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أَنَسٍ ﵁ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ قَالَ: كُلُّ ابْنِ آدَمَ خَطَّاءٌ وَخَيْرُ الْخَطَّائِينَ التَّوَّابُونَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الترمذي وقَالَ: هذا حديث غريب باب في استعظام المُؤْمِنِ ذنوبه ...رقم:٢٤٩٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Anas (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ said: “Every one of the children of Adam is a sinner! The best of those who sin is the one who makes tawbah to Allah.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ جَابِرِ بنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ ﵄ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللهِﷺ يَقُولُ: إِنَّ مِنْ سَعَادَةِ الْمَرْءِ أَنْ يَطُولَ عُمْرُهُ وَيَرْزُقَهُ اللهُ اْلإِنَابَةَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه الحاكم وقَالَ:هذا حديث صحيح الاسناد ولم يخرجاه ووافقه الذهبي:٢٤٠/٤
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Jabir ibn Abdullah (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “A person's life being lengthened, and his being granted the good fortune of turning towards Allah Ta'ala, are among that person's blessings.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ اْلاَغَرِّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: يَاأَيُّهَا النَّاسُ! تُوبُوا إِلَي اللهَ فَإِنِّي أَتُوبُ إِلَي اللهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ مِائَةَ مَرَّةٍ.
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Agharr (RA) narrates that Rasulullah ﷺ said: “O people, seek forgiveness for your sins from Allah Ta'ala, for I seek forgiveness for sins from Allah Ta'ala a hundred times every day.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنِ ابْنِ الزُّبَيْرِ ﵄ يَقُولُ: يَا أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ!إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ كَانَ
